title: diplotaxis harra subsp. intricata
intro: Diplotaxis harra subsp. intricata, commonly known as mountain rocket or Syrian rocket, is a subspecies of the Diplotaxis harra plant, which is an annual herb in the family Brassicaceae. The health benefits of Diplotaxis harra subsp. intricata include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may be useful in treating various conditions, including digestive issues and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Diplotaxis harra subsp. intricata include glucosinolates, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
